leads.title: Offre de stage à l'Organisation internationale pour les migrations (OIM)
leads.exclusion_reason: Six-month IOM internship in Brussels from February 2027 (WBI deadline 5 December 2026). At the time of applying the candidate must meet one of three conditions; the profile (not enrolled, Licence obtained in 2024) meets none: not 'inscrit.e en dernière année d’un programme universitaire de premier cycle', not pursuing graduate studies, and the third condition reads 'Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire et, s’il.elle est sélectionné.e, commencer le stage dans l’année suivant l’obtention de leur diplôme.' (a February 2027 start is more than a year after a 2024 degree). The page also states that candidates without a degree from, or studies at, a Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles institution are ineligible for the WBI grant ('leur profil est considéré comme étant inéligible pour la bourse octroyée par Wallonie-Bruxelles International').

leads.title: 2027 Fully Funded Youth Delegate Programme: Apply for the Council of Europe Congress in Strasbourg
leads.exclusion_reason: The organiser's own call (Congress of Local and Regional Authorities of the Council of Europe, call dated 4 November 2026, deadline 30 November 2026) lists under 'Profile of candidates' the requirement: 'live in and hold the passport of one of the 46 Council of Europe member States'. The profile records nationality and residence as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is not a Council of Europe member State and is not mentioned on the call. The call does fund travel, subsistence and accommodation, but only for delegates who meet that rule. The call is a PDF on rm.coe.int (HTTP 200 to the repo reader as a binary PDF, so the text was extracted from those bytes with a PDF parser; WebFetch gets 403); the aggregator page named by the lead (opportunitiesforyouth.org) reproduces the same sentence.

leads.title: Global Youth Forum 2027 in Italy: €600 Scholarships Available for Eligible Applicants
leads.exclusion_reason: A paid training course, not a funded forum. The organiser (International Training Centre of the ILO, Turin; Global Youth Forum 2027, 18-29 January 2027) lists the price as Tuition €2,330 and Subsistence €1,620, Total €3,950, and offers only partial awards: ‘ITCILO scholarships of €600 EUR available to nationals of countries included in the DAC list of ODA recipients’ (scholarship applications by 20 November 2026; course deadline 3 December 2026). Even with the award the applicant would pay about €3,350 plus flights and a Schengen visa.

leads.title: Young Political Economy Forum Hong Kong 2026 (Fully Funded)
leads.exclusion_reason: Fee and closed deadline on the organiser's page (CIPES, with The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong): a paid forum (Self Funded '$ 599 / delegate', Forum Access '$ 200 / delegate') where even the 'Fully Funded' route is listed at '$ 16.99 awarded on merit', and 'Your place is confirmed only once registration and payment are complete beforehand, including for delegates awarded funding.' Only 10 full awards (airfare support 'ranging from USD 300 to USD 1,000'). The page's deadline reads 'NOV 12' and the forum runs 17-20 December 2026, so the call is also closed. The aggregator's 'Fully Funded' title overstates it.

leads.title: Human Rights Summit 2027 in Canada (Fully Funded)
leads.exclusion_reason: Application fee on the organiser's page (Voice for Rights International, vfri.ca): 'Pay the applicable processing fee and submit your application.' It is not fully funded: only '100% Conference Fee Waiver for 20 selected delegates' with 'Partial Airfare Support in the Form of Reimbursement'; the rest are partially sponsored or self-sponsored delegates. Deadline 30 November 2026; summit 21-24 May 2027 in Vancouver. All nationalities aged 16+ may apply, so the DRC is not excluded; the fee is the problem. 'Fully Funded' appears only on the aggregator.

leads.title: London Youth Diplomacy Forum 2027 in the UK (Fully Funded)
leads.exclusion_reason: Fee-based and unverifiable. The only page found is the aggregator post itself, which says 'Complete the Form and pay the required application fees' and lists 'Forum fee waiver of up to $500' (so a forum fee exists) plus a self-funded 'Direct Forum Access' category. The organiser is named only as 'Youth Diplomatic Academy (YDA)'; the post links no official event page of its own, two web searches found no official YDA website (only copies of the same post on other aggregators, one of which gives an application fee of $29), and its two application forms are Cognito Forms pages that show only a title to the readers. The 'fully funded' wording therefore exists only on aggregators and is attached to a paid application.
leads.archive_reason: closed by research (REJECTED - NOT A LEGITIMATE OPPORTUNITY)
